subject: Christmas store gift: 500ml tumbler with logo
body:
Hi China team,

We need 3,000 pcs of 500ml stainless tumblers for Christmas store gifts.
Budget around USD 3.5-4.5 /pc FOB.
One-color logo laser or silk print is fine.
Need samples in 10 days, bulk before Nov 20.
Please advise which factories can do this and rough quotes.

Thanks,
Emma Lindberg
Nordic Retail Group

subject: Need 10000mAh power bank for tech conference
body:
Hello,

Looking for 800 pcs 10000mAh power banks with our logo for a Silicon Valley conference.
Must have CE/FCC and preferably UN38.3 docs for shipping.
Target budget USD 8-11/pc.
Can you shortlist China suppliers and estimated lead time?

Jason Cole
BrightWave Marketing

subject: Eco tote bag for new skincare launch
body:
こんにちは、中国チームの皆さま

新作スキンケア発売のノベルティで、オーガニック感のある帆布トート 2,000枚を探しています。
片面1色ロゴ、できれば再生素材。予算は1枚あたり RMB 6-9 くらい。
候補工場と概算見積もりをお願いします。

佐藤美咲

subject: Umbrella giveaway 5,000 pcs
body:
Dear team,

We need 5,000 folding umbrellas for insurance branch giveaway in Dubai.
Prefer UV coating, one logo print.
Budget is tight: about USD 2.2-3.0/pc.
Please recommend factories and MOQ/lead time.

Omar

subject: Member gift set: hoodie + tumbler
body:
Hi,

For 2026 member kit we want:
1) 1,200 hoodies with embroidery logo (EU sizes)
2) 1,200 pcs 500ml tumblers
Total gift budget about EUR 18-22 per set.
Please suggest matching factories in China and rough split quotes.

Jonas Weber
